For your future employer, we are looking for an enthusiastic and motivated Logistics Employee. In this versatile role, you will be responsible for various activities within the warehouse. Your duties will include operating a forklift, picking orders, checking incoming and outgoing goods, and loading and unloading trucks. In addition, you will accurately process goods movements in the WMS system, ensuring that inventory and orders are always kept up to date.

You work accurately, enjoy being physically active, and feel comfortable working in a logistics environment as part of a team. With your commitment and dedication, you will help ensure that logistics processes run smoothly and efficiently and that goods are processed and prepared correctly.
